## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO).
- [ ] `uv run pytest` and `uv run ruff check` pass.
- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] No measured answer changes, or the measurement is included (a run under `runs/` or a bit-identity check).
- [ ] No benchmark item text, keys, machine addresses or personal data in any file.
- [ ] Touches the served path: yes / no. If yes, a maintainer runs the GPU tests before merge.
- [ ] AI assistance used: yes / no.
